comments.text:
(Regarding: 32:28)

I feel like in a lot of ‘Revenge Stories’ the Main Characters are always so set on revenge that they never find a reason to live beyond enacting it. I feel like it’s very rare to see the MCs find someone or something else that drives them to keep on going. 

I think it’s interesting to see stories do this, but it would be nice to see the MCs actually want to survive (after only seeking vengeance) and have that be the driving point for the rest of the story. I’m curious to see what they’ll do for this game — since I’m going in spoiler free — but I don’t have high hopes for Atsu living considering the prequel … it’ll still be fun to see how they go about telling this narrative though! (But, hey, it’s also a possibility that she’ll end up living to be a foil to the MC of Ghost of Tsushima so 🤷‍♀️)
